prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1486; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling on the roadway in League City, Texas, and was turning left when the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle was proceeding through the intersection. Driver 1 reported a wrist injury at the scene. The force and direction of the impact are consistent with the injury Driver 1 described. Driver 1 was seated in the vehicle when the collision occurred, and both the responding officer and the witnesses at the scene confirmed this. Driver 2 gave a statement describing the collision in the same sequence Driver 1 reported. Two witnesses independently described the events consistent with both accounts. Scene photographs were taken and show damage concentrated along the side of Driver 1's vehicle, which matches the described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene, and both drivers were advised to exchange insurance information and seek medical evaluation as needed.
